title: QCOM Stock Extends Gains Overnight: Analyst Says Amazon AI Deal 'Changes Calculus For Qualcomm'
title_zh: 高通股票隔夜延续涨势：分析师称亚马逊人工智能交易“改变了高通的计算方式”
summary: Amazon’s custom AI silicon push gives Qualcomm a fresh growth avenue beyond smartphones, with analysts reassessing the chipmaker’s prospects.
summary_zh: 亚马逊推出的定制人工智能芯片为高通提供了智能手机之外的新增长途径，分析师重新评估了这家芯片制造商的前景。

title: States That Gave Data Centers Billions in Tax Breaks Are Now Ripping Up the Deals
title_zh: 为数据中心提供数十亿美元税收减免的州现在正在取消交易
summary: Amazon, Meta and Google risk losing decadeslong exemptions due to a backlash against their facilities.
summary_zh: 亚马逊、Meta 和谷歌可能会因其设施遭到强烈抵制而失去长达数十年的豁免权。

title: Constellation Energy's Biggest AI Power Deal Doesn't Start Paying Until June 2027
title_zh: Constellation Energy 最大的人工智能电力交易要到 2027 年 6 月才会开始付款
summary: Meta signed a 20-year deal built around one Illinois nuclear plant. The first contracted dollar is still nine months away.
summary_zh: Meta 签署了一项围绕伊利诺伊州一座核电站建设的 20 年协议。距离第一笔签约美元还有九个月的时间。

title: Qualcomm Stock Pops as Amazon Deal Ramps Up AI Ambitions
title_zh: 随着亚马逊交易增强人工智能野心，高通股价上涨
summary: The chip maker and online retailer are teaming up to build data-center infrastructure, including chips and optical networking products.
summary_zh: 这家芯片制造商和在线零售商正在联手建设数据中心基础设施，包括芯片和光网络产品。

title: Qualcomm and Amazon ink deal for custom data center chips
title_zh: 高通和亚马逊签署定制数据中心芯片协议
summary: Qualcomm has signed a custom data center chip deal with Amazon.
summary_zh: 高通已与亚马逊签署了定制数据中心芯片协议。
